title: Adhd/asd new user Lissy_Au
body:
Hi fellow ND people! I too suffer from executive dysfunction functioning difficulties- diagnosis of a few things: in some areas of my life / I suck- to put it blatantly it seems always a vicious cycle- do to much for too long- burnout- burn out recovery-mentally healthy and then it repeats….

I’m hoping with this daily streak and choosing my own manageable tasks wether it’s 1 task or 10- my tasks can carry over to the next day when I’m burnout and can’t do as many as I had tried - even with the free version it’s essentially the same as paying to say what day the reminder is for- as long as it’s done the app is happy lol. 

Give it a go- I heard good adds about it on social media and gave it a go- you should too.
author: Lissy Aú
